claims.statement: EU rules establish certification requirements for natural and legal persons working on stationary refrigeration, air conditioning, and heat pumps.
UDT publishes Polish registers for certified personnel and certified enterprises.

contrary_evidence: The public UDT register already supports manual verification at no charge.
Equipment manufacturers may bundle similar records into their own service apps.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: sell through two regional HVAC wholesalers and certified installer associations.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 250 wholesalers and service networks across CEE could create a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in eight to ten years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: onboarding one wholesaler at a time keeps founder work below 18 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: verification software could reach 70% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: customer acquisition pays back within four months at one active wholesaler branch.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge wholesalers 2,500 PLN monthly plus 8 PLN per verified service event.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: recurring installations, leak checks, and certificate changes sustain use.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A credential-to-equipment service graph reveals repeat compliance failures and trusted contractors
fingerprint.customer: HVAC and heat-pump wholesalers with certified installer channels
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Verification API, signed service ledger, and compliance dashboard subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The wholesaler pays when credentials and service events are verified
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Equipment or refrigerant is released for work without a current credential and auditable record

founder_fit: The parents' installation company offers a lawful design-partner environment.
The business rewards workflow automation more than high-energy public selling.
risks: Register access may not support reliable automated queries.
Wholesalers may resist responsibility for policing installer eligibility.

structure.control_point: Technician eligibility check and signed service event at equipment handoff
structure.critical_dependency: Wholesaler integrations and authoritative certificate-status access

thesis: Embed certificate verification and immutable service records into the equipment-sale and maintenance workflow of HVAC wholesalers.
title: F-Gas Credential and Service Ledger
uncertainties: The frequency and cost of current verification failures are unknown.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
